The '''Rebel Outpost''', also called '''Rebel Alliance Outpost''', was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Sony" />
